items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: Appointment is Monday 14.12.2026. 'Werktage' = Monday–Saturday excluding public holidays. Counting back from the appointment: 1 Werktag before = Saturday 12.12.2026; 2 Werktage before = Friday 11.12.2026 (no NW public holidays in this window). So cancellation must reach the practice by Friday 11.12.2026 at the latest to satisfy the 'at least two Werktage before' requirement. This is a private contractual notice period and is not shifted by weekend/holiday rules.
